hints.title: Bids Data Modeling
hints.text: Maintain a dictionary mapping item_id to a user bid map: bids[item_id][user_id] = amount.

hints.title: Withdraw and Highest Queries
hints.text: Deleting a user bid is a dictionary removal. Highest bid is the maximum value in bids[item_id] or 0.

hints.title: Constant / Linear Lookup Tradeoff
hints.text: Using a nested hash map provides O(1) place and withdraw operations.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(1) for place and withdraw, O(U) for getHighestBid
complexity.notes: Here I is number of items and U is number of bidders per item.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear array scan for each bid slows down lookups.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Nested hash map gives simple and robust state tracking.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects clean encapsulation and handling absent bids with 0.
